## PRB1.3. Safety

-   In 2025, Skyguide achieved the planned maturity levels set out in its performance plan for all five components of the EoSM. In more detail, Skyguide exceeded the planned level in the area of Safety Culture.

-   The rate of runway incursions (RI) was 3.32 at airport level, higher than the Union-wide average, and higher than the rate of RIs in 2024. The rate of RIs with ANS contribution was 1.11, higher than the Union-wide average, and higher than the rate of RIs with ANS contribution in 2024.

-   The rate of separation minima infringements (SMIs) at State level was 13.08, and at ANSP level 6.89. Both indicators were above the Union-wide average. When comparing to 2024, rate of SMIs has increased at both State level and at ANSP level.
